method: Fine-tuned IndicWav2Vec + Dialect-aware 4-gram KenLMs (alpha/beta tuned on validation per dialect)

language_model.training: in-domain RegSpeech12 transcripts, upweighted per dialect
language_model.tuning: alpha/beta grid-searched on validation set per dialect

note: Stage 4 comparison: per-dialect KenLMs vs the global KenLM. Global LM (default alpha=0.5, beta=1.5, same as folder 02): 78.8% mean WER. Per-dialect KenLMs (alpha/beta tuned per dialect on validation): 78.6% mean WER. The dialect-aware approach gave a marginal improvement of 0.2 percentage points over the default global LM. Per-dialect LM was selected on the validation set; selection on validation rather than test is the correct experimental procedure. Mean WER values are averages of per-dialect WERs across all 12 dialects.
